name: 29. OpenAI Responses Lifecycle + Streaming Retrieve
description: Pins the OpenAI Responses secondary-verb lifecycle on both the native /v1/responses/{id} routes and the /openai/v1 drop-in: retrieve, streaming retrieve (GET ?stream=true, newly added — BifrostResponsesRetrieveRequest.Stream -> ResponsesRetrieveStreamRequest -> provider.ResponsesRetrieveStream), input_items, and delete. Each chain creates a background + store + stream response (id parsed from the SSE create body, so streaming retrieve resumes an actually-streamed response), verifies the verbs against the captured id, and deletes it as cleanup. Cancel is omitted (it would abort the response the streaming retrieve replays).

item.name: openai/gpt-4o-mini native lifecycle: create streamed background response

exec: pm.test('native create (streamed bg): 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });

pm.test('native create (streamed bg): SSE content-type', function () { var ct = pm.response.headers.get('content-type') || ''; pm.expect(ct, 'expected text/event-stream, got ' + ct).to.include('text/event-stream'); });
var body = pm.response.text() || '';
var m = body.match(/"id":"(resp_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)"/);
pm.test('native create (streamed bg): captured streamed response id', function () { pm.expect(m, 'no resp_ id in SSE body head: ' + body.slice(0, 200)).to.not.equal(null); });
if (m) { pm.collectionVariables.set('lcNativeRespId', m[1]); }

body.raw:
{
  "model": "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
  "input": "Reply with exactly: lifecycle-ok",
  "store": true,
  "background": true,
  "stream": true
}

exec: pm.test('native retrieve: 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test('native retrieve: id matches create', function () { pm.expect(j.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('lcNativeRespId')); });
pm.test('native stream retrieve: 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });

pm.test('native stream retrieve: SSE content-type', function () { var ct = pm.response.headers.get('content-type') || ''; pm.expect(ct, 'expected text/event-stream, got ' + ct).to.include('text/event-stream'); });

pm.test('native stream retrieve: body is a responses SSE stream', function () { var body = pm.response.text() || ''; pm.expect(body.indexOf('data:'), 'expected SSE data lines').to.not.equal(-1); pm.expect(body.indexOf('response.'), 'expected response.* events').to.not.equal(-1); });
pm.test('native input_items: 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test('native input_items: object list', function () { pm.expect(j.object).to.eql('list'); });
pm.test('native delete: 2xx', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.be.below(400); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test('native delete: deleted true', function () { pm.expect(j.deleted).to.eql(true); });
